content:
The **Helvetia Bookstore** is a building within the Appalachian town of Helvetia.

The northernmost building in town, it can be accessed from the different doors. Inside, the northwestern room has many empty bookshelves and some couches and chairs. The central room has only a few ballot printers, while the northeastern room has two Cash Registers.

The Helvetia Bookstore appears in *Fallout 76*.
